newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU farm ministers to show "green fingers".
newsitem.headline: EU farm ministers to show "green fingers".

text.p: European Union farm ministers will on Tuesday roll up their sleeves and bend their backs to plant saplings and add a touch of greenery to the cavernous courtyard of the EU headquarters in Brussels.

"It will demonstrate that agricultural ministers have green fingers," said a Dutch EU Presidency official, adding that the ceremony will be celebrated with song and dance in keeping with a 40-year Dutch tree planting tradition.
Identical trees will be planted by each of the 15 ministers as well as Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler in two semi-circular banks of sand laid on top of the cobbled courtyard.
Officials dismissed fears that the sandbanks could be washed away by rainstorms or to confirm suggestions that the trees were "weeping willows."
